The '''Universal Power Adaptor''' was manufactured by [[Udrane Galactic Electronics]]. It allowed individuals to use power access interfaces across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] by using a number of variable input adaptors to match the [[Power coupling/Legends|power couplings]] or ratings of the individual's equipment to the local supply.
